name: Chicken Cordon Bleu Bake
ingredients_verbatim: 4 large, thick boneless, skinless chicken breasts
4 slices ham, cut in half lengthwise to make 8 pieces
4 slices Swiss cheese, cut in half lengthwise to make 8 pieces
8 oz. cream cheese, cut into cubes and softened
why: True oven bake (375F, 30 min), squarely mid-band at 480 cal / 5g carbs / 44g protein. Structurally low-carb: seared chicken breast layered with ham and swiss under a cream-cheese/parmesan/sour-cream/mayo sauce, no pasta or starch. Maps cleanly to board (chicken-breast, diced-ham, cream-cheese, parmesan, sour-cream, mayonnaise, chicken-broth, dijon-mustard, olive-oil, poultry-seasoning); only swiss cheese lacks a specific board home. Scales fine to 14 as a weigh-and-divide bake.
